summary: The recorded base reproducibly drops the gateway-injected DP rank during ResponsesRequest validation. The exact candidate declares and migrates both rank spellings, applies the established header-over-body precedence, forwards the effective rank into the initial GenerateReqInput, and retains it across built-in-tool continuation requests. Candidate regression tests and independent adversarial adapter tests pass.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-d3e744e8f59d/venv/bin/python -c '<construct ResponsesRequest with data_parallel_rank=4 and assert routed_dp_rank==4>' (at base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365)
tests.what_was_measured: Issue-specific failing-before reproduction: source imports resolved to /job/repo/python; ResponsesRequest discarded data_parallel_rank and exposed neither data_parallel_rank nor routed_dp_rank.
Candidate regression and neighboring Responses API coverage: 61 tests and 2 subtests passed, including schema preservation/migration, body forwarding, header precedence, and missing-rank behavior.

Independent serving-adapter cases: legacy body rank reached GenerateReqInput; canonical body rank beat the deprecated alias; header rank 0 beat body rank; body rank 0 survived; invalid header was rejected with HTTP 400.

tests.what_was_measured: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was visible as gfx950; Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported HIP 7.2.26015 and one available GPU.

gpu_execution.evidence: No model or GPU kernel was run. The defect is at the deterministic Pydantic-to-GenerateReqInput boundary, so GPU numerical execution would not establish routing-field preservation. Hardware visibility was recorded separately.

remaining_limitations: No multi-rank DP server, model weights, distributed scheduler, or multi-node workload was launched; validation ends at the actual GenerateReqInput passed toward tokenizer-manager/scheduler code.
The available architecture was a single gfx950 AMD Instinct MI350X. This review makes no claims about full inference, semantic accuracy, or distributed execution.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changed only Python, tests, and report files; imports were explicitly pinned to /job/repo/python rather than an installed SGLang wheel.
